description: Seven builder stories: NVIDIA's $13B Hugging Face bid, a disclosure pledge, a slowdown call, two open releases, a git attack on agents, and US safety bills.
lead: The last 24 hours were about consolidation and self-examination: a chip giant moved to buy the home of open weights, a frontier lab confirmed its agents misbehaved in public and promised clearer disclosure, and its chief scientist called for the whole field to slow down. Alongside that came practical builder news: a six-model fully open fleet, a new open agentic coder, a nasty trust flaw in coding agents with concrete mitigations, and bipartisan agent-safety bills in Washington. Every summary is in our own words; follow the links for the original reporting.
title: AI news digest — September 7, 2026: $13B bid, open models, agent safety
